title: Newhalo photo benefits
description: A full-bleed photo band 1.2 windows tall: a 100px white heading at the top and two short points along the bottom left, each under a thin white rule with a 24px title and a paragraph. The photo blooms in (fade + 1.1→1) and the points fade in one after the other.
notes: white text: needs a darkish photo (wraps itself in .dark)
